agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Action 16 reused Fake Out after Ohmnomnom had already used fresh-entry Fake Out and Spark; the move could not execute outside fresh entry, made no progress, and let 3-HP Eelektrik KO Ohmnomnom.

resolution.observed: hybrid-policy-v18 generically vetoes non-fresh Fake Out and selects Nuzzle; one exact replay verified Nuzzle KO'd Eelektrik before any reply and preserved Ohmnomnom at 4 HP.

findings.summary: Lildozer and Bushtank fainted after completing Ponyta and Eelektrik damage roles; neither was cycled through a no-action switch.
Birdlaw and Bugatti converted the Dustox endgame into a forced Rollout KO and Sunflora damage before fainting; full-HP Croakatoa then safely finished.
All eight switches were purposeful matchup entries or forced replacements. Every voluntary replacement acted before leaving; there was no switch reversal or no-action switch spam.
The battle used 25 decisions; replacing the failed second Fake Out with the verified immediate KO should shorten the next branch and preserve Ohmnomnom.

correct_choices: Fresh-entry Fake Out was effective at actions 14 and 18; the only defect was the now-vetoed non-fresh reuse at action 16.
Croakatoa pivoted to Bushtank for Eelektrik and later to Birdlaw for Dustox, with both replacements attacking before leaving.
No action was wasted into deterministic sleep or freeze.
The terminal state authoritatively verified victory with Croakatoa at 46/46 HP.
